name: Chef Laurent Dlamini
title: Executive Chef & Culinary Director
bio: Chef Laurent Dlamini's journey began in the kitchens of Cape Town before taking him through the Michelin-starred houses of Lyon and London. Over two decades he has refined a singular vision: bold, fire-driven cooking that honours African ingredients with European technique.

At Fusion Flame he leads a brigade of eighteen chefs around a custom-built open-flame hearth — the beating heart of the restaurant — where every steak, every catch, and every vegetable meets live fire before it meets your table.
philosophy: Fire is the oldest ingredient. Respect it, and it will give every plate a soul.
awards: SA Chef of the Year Finalist — 2022
Luxe Restaurant Awards: Best Grill Experience — 2024
